sources_used.source: Google Maps (real browser, visitor view; keyword queries per category, filtered to Sayreville/Parlin coordinates)
Business websites opened directly (wisniewskilaw.com, grossmanjustice.com, kumarbtrivedicpallc.com, hvhtechconsulting.com, vitaleinsurance.com, jordaninsagency.com)
Web search engine, many category + town queries

categories_thin: Financial and wealth advisers - mapped and searched several times; every financial planner/investment adviser with an office pin was in East Brunswick, Milltown or Old Bridge, and the in-town ones (Edward Jones, Ameriprise) are brand franchises the brief excludes. Likely most Sayreville advisers are home-based or meet clients elsewhere.

Property management - the in-town 'property management' hits are apartment complexes (London Terrace, Nieuw Amsterdam Village, Station Bay), which are not eligible; only one small management/service firm surfaced.

Staffing and employment agencies - mapped and searched; the only in-town hits were one Yellow Pages listing and one job-board trace. All employment agencies with real offices were in New Brunswick, Edison, East Brunswick or South Amboy.
Land surveying and environmental consulting - no Sayreville-based firm found; surveyors and environmental consultants were all in Old Bridge, Matawan, South River, Metuchen or East Brunswick.
Real estate appraisal - no Sayreville-based appraiser found.
Independent real estate brokerages - several in-town offices are Century 21 / RE-MAX / Weichert branches, which the brief excludes.
caveats: Parlin is an unincorporated section of Sayreville Township, so Parlin addresses (ZIP 08859) are recorded with town 'Parlin'.

Each Google Maps keyword query returns roughly 10-12 pins in an unsigned-in browser; about 20 keyword variants were used and unioned, so coverage is good for storefront practices but small home-based professional offices may be missed.

Branded franchise agencies were excluded per the brief: State Farm agent offices (John Pepe Jr., Juan Nava), Allstate agencies (Millennium/The Schreiner Agency, Thomas Schreiner), Edward Jones and Ameriprise adviser offices, H&R Block / Liberty Tax / Jackson Hewitt tax offices, and Century 21 / RE-MAX / Weichert real estate branches in town.

Websites are recorded only where a listing linked one or the site was opened. Most Google Maps pins show a 'Website' button whose URL is not exposed in the result list, so the triage team should follow those up.

Several entries are bulk-directory only (Pay Smart, Volk Insurance, Salaam Insurance, All Temp Logistics, Xtreme Business Consulting, Track Point Consulting, R D Crowley, Kiro Group) and are marked as such in active_evidence.
data_gaps: Overpass/OpenStreetMap API was unreachable from this environment (HTTP 406 and timeouts), so no OSM cross-check was possible.

Yellow Pages, BBB, Manta, Superpages, MapQuest, ChamberofCommerce.com, Justia, FindLaw, WhereOrg and LocalityBiz all returned HTTP 403 to both the fetch tool and the browser, so those bulk directories could not be mined directly (individual entries were only visible through search-result summaries).
No official Borough of Sayreville licensed-business list or economic-development directory is published online; the borough site publishes only agendas, minutes and tax-assessment documents.
The Old Bridge-Sayreville-South Amboy Chamber of Commerce site did not expose a public member directory.

A few entries have no street address (Courtney Lowry Architect, CNJ Property Services, Douglas R. D'Antonio, William A. Aitken, Flying Irishman Consulting, Cutting Edge Consulting, GotWorX Staffing) or only a slogan name (WE WANT TO BUY YOUR HOUSE).

Addresses near the township lines - Klimek Pl (some mail reads South Amboy 08879), NJ-35 (Morgan/Laurence Harbor), 37 Winding Wood Dr, 100 Plainfield Ave, 515 Washington Ave - are flagged in notes for township verification.
Refused/blocked pages: none required login, so no site was skipped for authentication; all blocks were bot-protection.
